scope: Native debug-core diagnostic of immediate preparation and subsequent typing fallback, not browser or release responsiveness
profile: Core Rust dev profile, tree-sitter and configured grammar packages optimized at level 2; editor-parser and test-support features
document: Document::new with default editor_limits=false; document construction and initial selection setup excluded from timing
